answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the marble check immediately, the ripple audit keeps the resolved set and the jade replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 103 aliases thus forfeits the reading cost 103 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
